survey: Round orange-framed clock standing upright on a green shelf. Frame: thick round orange ring, seen nearly face-on with a slight turn; round once perspective is allowed for, even thickness. Face: white dial inside the ring with 12 navy hour markers and minute dots; the minute hand covers the 2 o'clock marker. Hands: hour hand at ~10, minute hand at ~2, thin red second hand, all meeting at one red centre cap (correct count; the second hand has no tail, an acceptable simplification). Support: the clock stands straight on the bottom curve of its round frame with a contact shadow on the shelf, and has no feet, stand or back prop.

errors.where: Bottom of the orange frame where it touches the shelf
errors.what: The round clock stands upright on a single point of its curved rim with no feet, stand or prop; a real round clock like this would roll or tip over.

fix: Give the round clock two small rounded feet at the bottom of the orange frame, angled outward, so it stands steadily on the shelf. Or add a short stand behind it, like a desk clock.
